title: Hilltop Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Hilltop Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 28, 2026 announcing the appointment of two new independent directors, Dana Bober and Stephen Haworth, both effective April 23, 2026. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Hilltop Holdings Inc. appointed Dana Bober (age 56) and Stephen Haworth (age 64) as independent directors on April 23, 2026
Dana Bober was formerly a Partner and Americas Practice Leader at Ernst & Young LLP, retiring in June 2025
Stephen Haworth was CFO of Flexpoint Ford LLC from 2005 until appointed Vice Chairman in 2025
Both new directors received restricted stock units valued at $200,000, cliff vesting on April 23, 2029
Both directors were appointed to the Audit Committee; Haworth also joins the Compensation Committee
